title: Sara Duterte asks if Marcos had hand in father's transfer to The Hague

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday questioned whether Palace press officer Claire Castro was admitting that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. had a hand in bringing former President Rodrigo Duterte to The Hague, Netherlands, to face charges of crimes against humanity over his administration’s drug war. Duterte also slammed what she described as the “split personality” of officials in the Office of the President, citing the differing statements made by Castro and Marcos regarding the Philippines’ cooperation with the International Criminal Court (ICC).
